Green Environment Youth Korea

About GEYK

What GEYK Does

Green Environment Youth Korea (GEYK) is a youth-led climate organization that has been active since 2014.

We have organized Power Shift Korea, the Bee Project, the People’s Climate March, and skills-building sessions. Since 2014, we have attended the UN climate conferences (UNFCCC COP), held workshops and side events, built international networks, and strengthened our capacity for climate action.

Mission

GEYK works to help put the international climate framework into practice by supporting youth-led climate action, accelerating the shift to renewable energy, encouraging sustainable ways of living, and bringing young people’s voices to the international stage. Our vision is to build a sustainable society, deepen knowledge of climate change, make sustainable habits more accessible, and strengthen environmental networks.

Why We Act

Green: Taking Korean Youth to the Global Environmental Stage

GEYK gives young people opportunities to take part in international environmental work, broaden their perspectives, and learn from peers in other countries. We want more opportunities to grow and develop expertise alongside international youth organizations. Working across borders allows us to contribute more widely and gives young people a place to be creative and connect with others who care about the environment.

Environment: Putting Climate Solutions into Practice

Solutions begin in local communities. GEYK runs climate projects that respond directly and indirectly to local challenges and help young people lead that work. We review existing environmental policies and activities to identify what works, what needs improvement, and what new ideas could help. We bring a youth perspective to issues that governments may have overlooked so environmental policy can be practical and responsive.

Youth: Building Youth-Led Environmental Organizations

As awareness of environmental protection grew internationally and in Korea, young people interested in these issues still lacked lasting networks. Despite the importance of intergenerational equity, youth had few chances to lead. GEYK is a volunteer youth organization in Korea that drives change in local communities. We speak clearly about climate issues, act on them, and develop the skills to stay involved over time.

Korea: Raising Awareness of Climate Change in Korea

Climate change affects Korea’s economy, local environment, and everyday life. The government has promoted environmental programs and worked to raise awareness, yet many people remain disengaged or have difficulty turning awareness into action. Addressing climate change takes effort from government, industry, and citizens. GEYK works to communicate the seriousness of climate change and raise public awareness.

Vision

Building a Sustainable Society

We drive change in local communities, take part in efforts to cut greenhouse gas emissions, and work toward an environmentally sustainable society.

Climate Knowledge and Sustainable Living

We teach teenagers and young adults about climate change and sustainability so they can put environmentally friendly habits into practice and help change society.

Stronger Environmental Networks

We strengthen environmental networks in Korea and abroad, support environmental action by Korean youth, and help youth organizations take the lead. We aim to connect youth environmental networks across Asia and around the world.

About GEYK

GEYK is run by highly motivated youths committed to climate change issues. We believe that an inspiring vision and cross-generational cooperation are needed to solve the climate change crisis and create a sustainable future. GEYK is a youth platform in South Korea to share knowledge and experiences, take action locally and internationally, run projects and inspire people to care about climate change. We aim to have a role in decision-making on climate change policies to make the world sustainable, just and fair.
